runs.out: The official prebuilt Windows x64 CUDA-12 build of llama.cpp b9484 is Blackwell-correct and does not require CUDA toolkit, CMake, or Visual Studio. Extract the binary and cudart pack into the same folder. The CUDA-12 build should be used instead of CUDA-13, as it prevents MMQ kernel crashes and reduces performance by about five times. Verify that the MMQ is engaged with llama-bench: a 30B-A3B MoE should report prefill in thousands of tokens per second; if it reports around one thousand, build from source with CUDA 12.8 instead.

The Ollama qwen3.6 blob failed to load due to incorrect array length, while the gemma4 blob also failed. Ollama now uses its own inference engine, causing GGUF file divergence from upstream llama.cpp for newer models.

The convoy and relay mechanics allow party movement between settlements while bandits and weather threaten the route. Galen Rook leads a cast of Eli Winter, Ada Mercer, and Rosa Varela across sixteen chapters from Cedar Wake to the Bitter Cut.
